en-US.promotionalText: Train your darts, practise your doubles and finishing, and join your own private club. Free, no ads, no account and no in-app purchases. App in Dutch.
en-US.description:
Please note: the app is in Dutch.

OKKIE. is your personal darts trainer. Throw three darts, tap them in and instantly see whether you are getting better. For beginners, kids and keen darters.

TRAINING
• Score training of 30, 60 or 99 darts, free training or your own number of turns
• Big buttons: DOUBLE, TRIPLE, 1–20, 25, BULL and MISS, or type your throw (T20 5 D10)
• Around the clock: 1 to 20 and the bull, also doubles only or trebles only
• Targeted practice: Bob's 27 for your doubles and 121 Checkout for your finishing, with a record and weekly trend
• Practice today: a suggestion based on your own numbers, always showing the figures behind it
• Weekly goal: choose how often you want to train each week
• A personal target just above your own level

PLAY TOGETHER
• Train together with up to 8 players taking turns, with a ranking
• 301 or 501 match for 1 to 4 players, double-out or straight-out, with checkout suggestions
• Every player keeps their own statistics

OKKIE. CLUB
• Start a private club for your darts association or team for free, or join with an invite
• An admin approves new members; only club members can see the club
• Weekly club challenge with ranking and club record, also with Bob's 27 and 121 Checkout
• For players aged 16 and over; only summarised results are sent to the server

SEE YOURSELF IMPROVE
• Average per 3 darts, best and worst training, 100+, 140+ and 180
• Chart per training, day, week or month with a trend line
• Hit map: which part of the board you hit most often
• Records and 39 badges, with a little celebration for your first 180
• Spoken encouragement if you want it

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No account needed, no ads, no in-app purchases
• Everything is stored on your own iPhone and works without internet
• Save a backup to Files or iCloud Drive, and move from Safari to the app with a transfer code
• Want to show your numbers to other darters? You can in Darters, per player and only if you switch it on yourself

OKKIE. is made by Denckh. in the Netherlands.

reviewNotes:
OKKIE. is a darts training app (Dutch). No account or login is needed; all training data is stored on the device and the app works fully offline (all web assets are bundled in the app, no remote content).

How to test: enter a name, tap "Trainen" and "Start scoretraining", then tap three darts (e.g. TRIPLE + 20). Statistics, the hit map (Stats tab), 301/501 matches (Wedstrijd tab), targeted practice (Trainen > Gericht oefenen) and backups (Meer > Back-up bewaren in Bestanden, via the share sheet) are all on-device.

New in 1.10.0, "OKKIE. Club" (Home > OKKIE. Club): a private space per darts club for users aged 16+. To test: Home > OKKIE. Club > "Gratis een club oprichten", enter a club name, confirm; you are the club admin. The Beheer tab shows the invite code; joining with that code from a second device creates a request the admin approves. Club content (club name, logo, club trainings with a short description written by the admin, results that members choose to share) is visible only to approved members of that club. The club feed only lists training summaries members share themselves (type, score, date); there are no likes, comments, direct messages or public discovery. Users can report a member, club name, logo or club training by e-mail (Leden and Trainingen tabs) and hide members on their device; admins can remove members, results and feed items; we review reports within a few days and remove content or clubs.

Optional "Darters": a public leaderboard of nicknames and summary stats that each player can opt into per player. Players under 16 only appear after a parent confirms via a link. Users can hide any darter and report a profile by e-mail (Darters > tap a name). "Hulp & feedback" sends a support message to our own server.

New in 1.11.0, "Club at the board": a club admin can print a poster with a QR code (Beheer tab > QR-code bij het bord > Poster afdrukken; opens in Safari for printing) and create a single-use personal invite link (Beheer > Persoonlijke uitnodiging, valid 14 days). Per code the admin chooses whether new players need approval (default) or join directly. Scanning opens the club page where the player picks or creates a local player and joins (16+ confirmation required, enforced by the server). Automatically sharing training summaries with the club is a separate opt-in that is off by default; otherwise members share per training. To test: create a club as above, open the Beheer tab and tap "Poster afdrukken" or "Uitnodiging maken"; on a second device enter the code under Home > OKKIE. Club.

New in 1.12.0: the club's own trainings come first. The first club tab is now "Trainingen": the admin creates club trainings (name, type, number of darts, period), each with its own ranking, and members can start one with "Gooi deze training". With the opt-in automatic sharing (off by default) a finished training also counts for a matching club training. The fixed weekly exercise is now optional (Beheer > Vaste weekoefening). No new data types, no new permissions. To test: create a club as above; the Trainingen tab opens with the form "Nieuwe clubtraining".

No ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking. Native features: haptics, share sheet (save to Files), local file storage for data durability, status bar.
